US-01.story: As an academic/registration administrator, I want to register a student so that a valid student record exists in UniFlow.
acceptance_criteria: A valid registration number is accepted and preserved.
A student number is derived from the registration number.
The derived student number is unique regardless of PS/EVE.
Required student and programme fields are validated before registration is completed.

US-02.story: As an administrator, I want student email addresses validated so that student records use the expected university email format.
acceptance_criteria: A valid university student email is accepted.
An invalid format is rejected.
The email is stored with the student record after successful validation.

US-03.story: As an administrator, I want duplicate derived student numbers rejected so that PS and EVE do not create two records for the same student number.
acceptance_criteria: A second record with an existing derived student number is rejected.
The PS/EVE suffix does not make the derived student number unique.
The system reports a clear validation error.

US-04.story: As an administrator, I want study mode restricted to supported programme/year combinations so that students cannot be registered into an unavailable mode.
acceptance_criteria: Only defined PS/EVE combinations are accepted.
An unsupported programme/year/mode combination is rejected.
The reason for rejection is recorded or displayed.

US-05.story: As a student, I want to enroll for a semester so that I can proceed to course registration.
acceptance_criteria: A valid student can enroll for the applicable semester.
Required prerequisite conditions for enrollment are checked.
An invalid/ineligible enrollment request is rejected.
Enrollment status is stored and available to later course-registration checks.

US-06.story: As a student, I want to register for an eligible course so that my semester registration reflects my approved study plan.
acceptance_criteria: The course belongs to the student's programme or is otherwise explicitly eligible.
The course is available for the semester/year.
Required enrollment and eligibility checks pass before registration.

US-07.story: As a student, I want prerequisite requirements checked so that I cannot register for a course without satisfying its prerequisites.
acceptance_criteria: A student who has satisfied all prerequisites can register.
A student missing a required prerequisite is rejected.
The unmet prerequisite is identifiable in the validation result.

US-08.story: As a student, I want my course load limited according to year so that I cannot exceed the UniFlow maximum.
acceptance_criteria: Year 1 maximum is 6 units.
Year 2 maximum is 6 units.
Year 3 maximum is 5 units.
Year 4 maximum is 4 units.
A registration that exceeds the applicable limit is rejected.

US-09.story: As a student, I want duplicate course registrations prevented so that the same course cannot be registered twice in one applicable period.
acceptance_criteria: A course can be registered only once for the applicable semester/period.
A duplicate request is rejected.
The existing registration is not duplicated or corrupted.

US-10.story: As an administrator, I want a timetable generated within UniFlow constraints so that teaching sessions do not create prohibited conflicts.
acceptance_criteria: Day sessions fall within 08:00-16:00.
Evening sessions fall within 16:30-20:30.
Each course is taught at least once and at most twice per week.
Student, lecturer and room conflicts are detected/prevented.
The generated timetable contains identifiable course, time and room information.
